summary.en: Salvadoran President Bukele confirmed an airstrike that destroyed gang leader Jeff's luxury mansion, and Salvadoran forces later demolished another gang stronghold, killing about 20 gang members. Haiti formalised a security pact with El Salvador and deployed Salvadoran troops who have engaged in combat against gangs, prompting both supportive and oppositional street protests in Port-au-Prince. The United Nations warned that anti-gang operations must prioritise civilian protection, and the EU imposed sanctions on four Haitian gangs for serious human rights violations. 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Salvadoransk president Bukele bekreftet et luftangrep som ødela gjenglederen Jeffs luksusvilla, og salvadoranske styrker rev senere ned en annen gjengbase, og drepte omtrent 20 gjengmedlemmer. Haiti formaliserte en sikkerhetspakt med El Salvador og satte inn salvadoranske tropper som har vært i kamp mot gjenger, noe som førte til både støttende og motstandende gateprotester i Port-au-Prince. FN advarte om at anti-gjeng-operasjoner må prioritere sivile, og EU innførte sanksjoner mot fire haitiske gjenger for alvorlige brudd på menneskerettighetene. 193 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
